rows.jyutping: gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 zau1 wai4 haang4
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to describe a person or animal moving furtively around.

example.english: The cat would prowl around the back alleys all night.
example.traditional: 隻貓成晚喺後巷鬼鬼祟祟咁周圍行。
example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 seng4 maan5 hai2 hau6 hong2 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 zau1 wai4 haang4

rows.jyutping: gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 zau1 wai4 wan2
rows.note: Use this when the focus is furtively looking around for prey, valuables, or something else.

example.english: The thief would prowl around furtively, apparently looking for valuables.
example.traditional: 個賊鬼鬼祟祟咁周圍搵，似乎想搵值錢嘢。
example.jyutping: go3 caak2 gwai2 gwai2 seoi6 seoi6 gam3 zau1 wai4 wan2 ci5 fu4 soeng2 wan2 zik6 cin2 je5

rows.note: Use this for stealthy movement in formal, military, wildlife, or game-related contexts.

example.english: The troops prowl stealthily under cover of darkness, slowly approaching the target.
example.traditional: 部隊喺夜色掩護下潛行，慢慢接近目標。
example.jyutping: bou6 deoi2 hai2 je6 sik1 jim2 wu6 haa6 cim4 hang4 maan6 maan2 zip3 gan6 muk6 biu1
